message: A few more fixes. After midnight but before your day starts, the reminder picker marks the day you’re still in as today and opens on its month, and a suggested all-day event for today is no longer turned away as already over. The red time-left countdown no longer shows on a task in a paused project or one waiting on another task, and Look ahead’s Carried over list leaves those out too. A task in a paused project doesn’t get a follow-up nudge about who it’s waiting on until the pause ends. Pausing a project no longer breaks the streaks of its repeating tasks when the pause ends. Reordering Later no longer moves tasks around on their project’s page. Undoing a task right after checking it off removes the event it added to your calendar. An item renamed while its aisle was being worked out keeps the right aisle, and a barcode scan or a substitute suggestion that finishes after you close the sheet no longer turns up the next time you open it.
